info.title: Wii U Client Selector
info.author: hadley557
info.details: Lets you swap between different Wii U servers (ex. Pretendo, Protarium) with a menu in the home menu. Make a folder in the root of your SD Card called "clients" and put your .wms and .wps files into a folder inside the "clients" folder, directly into that folder. Still a work in progress.

changelog: Nothing yet, sorry. I have more changes planned for the future though, mostly getting rid of random crashes and such.
